title: Family tree with name boxes (no drawings of people)
subject: Arabic
unit: Summer 1: My grandparents and relatives; the market; Ramadan and Eid
source: Written for arabic/y3 lesson 14 (Pupil PDF worksheet: family tree with name boxes (no drawings of people))
intro: Lesson 14: My grandfather, grandmother and relatives. Read the ideas from the lesson, then do the tasks.

blocks.text: Write a name in each box. Father's side: عَمّ, عَمَّة. Mother's side: خَال, خَالَة.

blocks.h: Two kinds of uncle and aunt

panels.title: Introducing a relative
points: هٰذَا جَدِّي (hadha jaddi): this is my grandfather
هٰذِهِ جَدَّتِي (hadhihi jaddati): this is my grandmother
هٰذَا for boys and men, هٰذِهِ for girls and women

questions.q: Make a family tree on the pupil PDF with names only (no drawings of people): label each box with the Arabic word and write two sentences with هٰذَا or هٰذِهِ.
questions.a: Correct labels (جَدّ، جَدَّة، عَمّ، عَمَّة، خَال، خَالَة) and two correct sentences

questions.q: Extend: write 'this is my aunt' for your mother's sister.
Stretch: say how many uncles you have: عِنْدِي ... أَعْمَام.
questions.a: For example: عِنْدِي عَمَّانِ (I have two uncles)
A) خَال. خَال (khal) is the mother's brother.

questions.q: Think again: why two words for uncle?
questions.a: To show which side of the family
